xna-type.name: TitleContainer
xna-type.summary: Provides file stream access to the title's default storage location.

method.name: OpenStream
method.summary: Returns a stream to an existing file in the default title storage location.

overload.summary: Returns a stream to an existing file in the default title storage location.

parameters.parameter: The name of the file to open.

overload.returns: The file stream that can be used to read the file's data.
overload.remarks: The stream returned is read-only. The file to be read must already exist, or this method will fail.
